content: W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding pages identify a 24x24 CSS px minimum target (with spacing/equivalence exceptions) at AA and recommend larger targets when practical; 2.3.3 animation from interactions is AAA and recommends removing unnecessary interaction-triggered motion or honoring reduced-motion preference. MDN documents prefers-reduced-motion as widely available and requestAnimationFrame/visibilitychange as native ways to render frame-timed motion and stop background updates. These findings support CSS media-query reduction and pausing the existing Three.js render loop/ambient motion; they do not justify adding an accessibility or animation dependency.
